Class BaseGameController

java.lang.Object
app.controller.multi.BaseGameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardObserver, ChatObserver, DeckObserver, LogObserver
Direct Known Subclasses:
GameClientController, GameController
public abstract class BaseGameController extends Object implements CardObserver, DeckObserver, LogObserver, ChatObserver
An abstract base class that serves as the controller for managing game logic in a multiplayer card game. This class implements various observer interfaces to handle updates and interactions with game components such as cards, decks, logs, and chat messages. It also manages the views, players, and game state.
